lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Okay, the light is good. Just talk to the camera, Macal.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Talk to the camera. Right. Easy.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: You've been quiet all week. What are you afraid to say?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: That if I say it out loud, I mean... it becomes real. And I could still fail.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أَهْلًا بِيكُمْ يا جَماعَة في Yalla Fluent! أَنا مَحْمُود، وَالنَّهَارْدَة مَعانا حَلْقَة حَلْوَة... ماكال بِيْسَجِّلْ الفِيدْيُو بُتاعُه مَعْ نُور!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَبِصْراحَة، هُوَ خايِف... عَشان لَمَّا تِقولْ حاجَة بِصوتْ عالي، بَتَبْقى حَقيقِيَّة.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: اسْمَعُوا كْوَيِّس عَشان تِلاتَة تَعابِير: في رَأْيي، وَلَمَّا كُنْت صُغَيَّر، وَأَنا ناوِي.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلَّا، خُشُّوا عَلى المَشْهَد... وَخَلُّوا وَدْنِكُمْ مَفْتُوحَة!

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Okay, forget the camera for a second. Talk to me. Why does this video scare you more than the interview did?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Because in an interview they ask the questions. Here, I have to choose the words. And in my opinion, my words are still... small.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Small? Macal, you moved to a new country alone. You're not small. Start there. When you were young, what did you want to be?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: When I was young, I wanted to build things. Real things. My father worked with his hands, and I watched him every day. I live here since two years, but I still hear his voice when I work.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: That's the truth I was waiting for. Don't lose it. Say it again, but this time look at the lens like it's him.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Okay. I'm not sure I can do this without shaking, but... I'm going to try. Baba, if you can hear me, I'm not done yet.
lines.direction: breathing deep, voice cracking then firm

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Good. Now the last part. What are you going to do with this chance if you get it?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: If I win Rising Voices, I'm going to build something for people like me. A place where our English is not perfect, but it's ours. I'm never going to hide again.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: You just said it without stopping. Did you notice? You didn't translate in your head.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I didn't notice. I was just... talking. To you, and to him. Maybe that's the difference.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Then that's the whole video. Don't change a word. Ready to go again for real?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Ready. And Nour... thank you. In my opinion, you saw me before I saw myself.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: طَيِّب... في المَشْهَد دَه ماكال قال تَعابِير حِلْوَة أَوِي. تَعالُوا نْشُوفْهُم مَعَ بَعْض... في رَأْيي، يَعْني in my opinion، لَمَّا تِعْبِر عَن رَأْيَك بِأَدَب. مَثَلًا: In my opinion, this idea is strong. وَتاني تَعْبِير... لَمَّا كُنْت صُغَيَّر، يَعْني when I was young، بِتَبْدَأ بِيهَا أَي حِكايَة مِن طُفُولْتَك. وَتالِتًا... أَنا ناوِي، يَعْني I'm going to، لِلْخُطَط الجايَة.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: بَس خُدْ بالَك مِن غَلْطَة صُغَيَّرَة... ماكال قال I live here since two years. دَه تَرْجَمَة حَرْفِيَّة مِن العَرَبي... في الإِنْجِليزي بِنْقول I've lived here for two years. عَشان since بِتْجِي مَعَ نُقْطَة بِدايَة، وَfor مَعَ مُدَّة.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَدِلْوَقْتي... الـ Accent Lab! النَّهَارْدَة عَلى الـ Intonation... لَحْن الجُمْلَة. الصوت بِطْلَع فُوق في الأَسْئِلَة، وَبِيِنْزِل في الجُمَل العادِيَّة. إسْمَعُوا... بعض الناس بِقولُو my words are still small... كِدَه مُسَطَّح. لَأ... إرْفَعُوا الصوت في الآخر... my words are still small! كَرِّرُوا مَعايا... Ready? Ready. كَرِّرُوا: my words are still small!

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Okay, that was three takes, and every single one was better than the last. I've been doing this for years, and I'm telling you, that last one was real.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I felt it. Usually my head is full of noise, but this time I was just... there. I'm not sure how to explain it.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: You don't have to explain it. You just have to press send. Come on, before you change your mind.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Wait, wait. Okay. I've lived here for two years, and this is the first time I feel like I belong in my own voice. So... I'm sending it.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: You did it. And the funny part? If you win, they'll fly you to Chicago for the final round. My whole family is there. You could meet them.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Chicago. Your city. That's a lot of pressure, habibti. I mean... a lot of pressure, Nour.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: You'll be fine. Baba says the city is big, but the people are warmer than the winter. You'll see.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Hang on, my phone. It's my sister. Give me one second, it might be about the apartment.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Take your time. I'm going to watch the video one more time. Just to check the sound, nothing else.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Hold on. This isn't my sister. Macal, look at this.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: What is it? Nour, you went pale. What does it say?

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: It's from the Chicago office. They want me back. Full-time. They said the offer is open, but I have to answer by Friday.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: ...That's amazing news. It's your dream, Nour. You should take it.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: طَيِّب يا جَماعَة... النَّهَارْدَة خُدْنا تَلات تَعابِير مَفْتُوحَة: in my opinion، عَشان تْقُول رَأْيَك؛ when I was young، عَشان تِبْدَأ حِكايَة؛ وَI'm going to، عَشان خُطَطَك الجايَة.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَفاكِر... ما تْقُولْش I live here since two years، قُول I've lived here for two years... since مَعَ البِدايَة، وَfor مَعَ المُدَّة.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَعِبارَة الحَلْقَة... هِيَّ... I've lived here for two years, and I feel like I belong in my own voice. جُمْلَة مِن القَلْب، فيها زَمَن، وَفيها إحْساس.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: دِلْوَقتي الدَّوْر عَلَيْك... سَجِّل voice note صُغَيَّر، قُول فيه الجُمْلَة دِي بِنَفْس النَّغْمَة اللي اتْدَرَّبْنا عَلَيْها... وَابْعَتَها لِـ Empire English Community عَلى تِليجْرام.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: إحْنا مِسْتَنيين نِسْمَع صَوْتَك... وَمِش هَنَقَيِّمَك، إحْنا هَنِشْجَّعَك! يالّا... إحْنا عائِلَة، وَأَصْواتنا بْتِكْبَر مَعَ بَعْض.

phrase_of_episode.en: I've lived here for two years

phonetic_focus.note: The melody of the sentence. Voice rises on yes/no questions, falls on statements and wh-questions. Wrong melody changes the meaning.
